display_long_description:
**JUST ONE MAN** is a VR hack-and-slash game where you are the **OVERPOWERED ONE-MAN ARMY**. Stylishly slaughter enemies with weapons, combo attacks and devastating abilities while listening to banging beats. Choose your own playstyle and invent the wildest combos to achieve the highest scores imaginable.
[media]
Visceral slices, impactful punches, lightning-fast dashing. The fighting is designed with one goal in mind: it has to feel **AS SATISFYING AS POSSIBLE**. Immerse yourself in the flow of the combat and become the ultimate martial arts master.
[media]
The basics are simple, everyone can learn them in minutes. It is up to you what kind of fighting style you want to come up with, but only the **COOLEST COMBOS** and **EDGIEST EXECUTIONS** earn you that sought-after SSS-rank.
[media]
Take on the **CHALLENGE LEVELS** and hone your skills as you conquer difficulties from Easy all the way to **GOD**. Learn new mechanics and tricks to achieve the highest scores. Get sucked into the thrill of the fight while listening to **BANGING BEATS**.
[media]
For the ultimate challenge, play the randomly generated **ENDLESS MODE**. Play as long as you can while the difficulty constantly ramps up. Show off your scores on the **GLOBAL LEADERBOARD**.

Will you make it through the emperor's armies, even though you are **JUST ONE MAN**?
